label_policy: action: an explicit instruction, condition, restriction, exemption or required response directed at the reader; contact: a route for questions/help, not a required operational response; event: logistics/availability/cost; background: descriptive, historical or courtesy text. Optional instructions retain their condition. Labels are assigned by the developer, not independently adjudicated.
limitations: Frozen before retraining. Authored cases are development challenges informed by observed weaknesses, not a blind test. Public excerpts are a tiny convenience sample, selected and labeled by the developer, not representative accuracy or user-benefit evidence. No excerpt is used for training. Each public page contributes at most 25 quoted words.
